_comment: Expectations after schema_migrations_input_dml.json. From manual session: 8 DML migrations on tester_transaction — CopyColumn(desc->desc_detailed), UpdateColumnValue(amount=202.57), AddColumnWithDefaultValue(operation_time=2005-05-28T20:57:00Z), SetColumnToNull(desc), CopyTable(transaction->transaction_new), RenameColumn(amount->amount_renamed), RenameTable(transaction_new->transaction_renamed), DropTable(transaction_drop). End state: tester_transaction has 6 rows with amount_renamed=202.57, desc=NULL, desc_detailed populated; tester_transaction_renamed exists; tester_transaction_drop and tester_transaction_new are gone.

assertions.name: tester_transaction has exactly 6 rows
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_transaction) t WHERE t.c <> 6

assertions.name: every tester_transaction row has amount_renamed = 202.57 (UpdateColumnValue)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction WHERE amount_renamed <> 202.57 OR amount_renamed IS NULL

assertions.name: every tester_transaction row has desc = NULL (SetColumnToNull)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction WHERE "desc" IS NOT NULL

assertions.name: every tester_transaction row has operation_time = 2005-05-28 20:57:00 (AddColumnWithDefaultValue)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction WHERE operation_time <> TIMESTAMP '2005-05-28 20:57:00'

assertions.name: tester_transaction_renamed exists (RenameTable)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction_renamed') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: tester_transaction_drop is dropped (DropTable)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction_drop'

assertions.name: tester_transaction_new is dropped (was renamed away)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction_new'

assertions.name: desc_detailed preserved original desc values via CopyColumn (id=10 -> 'three')
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction WHERE id = 10 AND desc_detailed <> 'three'

assertions.name: desc_detailed preserved original desc values via CopyColumn (id=20 -> 'money')
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction WHERE id = 20 AND desc_detailed <> 'money'
